newsitem.title: USA: TALX sees record Q3, nine months revenues.
newsitem.headline: TALX sees record Q3, nine months revenues.

text.p: TALX Corp, which provides computer telephony services, said on Monday it expects record revenues for its fiscal 1997 third quarter and nine months periods ending December 31, 1996.

TALX said it expects revenues from continuing operations in excess of $5 million for the quarter, a 55 percent increase over the same period last year, and revenues in excess of $13.85 million for the nine months, a 42 percent increase over last year.
TALX also said that, while its third quarter is not yet closed, the company has already reached the lower end of analysts' estimates for revenues.
Shares of TALX were trading up 1-5/8 to 7-1/2.
